data.one_liner: Flutter package to load Google Fonts at runtime or bundle them as assets
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to use Google Fonts in Flutter apps. It supports HTTP fetching, caching, and asset bundling, with a lightweight tree‑shakable Lite variant.
use_when: Need to use Google Fonts without adding large font files to the app
Want runtime font fetching during development
Want to bundle only the fonts you use to keep the app size small
avoid_when: You need a very small bundle and cannot afford the runtime fetch overhead
You prefer to manage fonts manually without the convenience API
strengths: Easy to use API with static and dynamic font methods
Tree‑shakable Lite variant reduces bundle size
weaknesses: Adds a dependency and potential runtime fetch delay
Large asset bundle if many fonts are bundled
Requires manual asset setup for offline use
data.setup_notes: Add `google_fonts` to pubspec dependencies. For offline bundling, download desired font files, place them in an assets folder, and list the folder under `assets:` in pubspec.yaml. No special permissions needed.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use for custom font fetching logic if you need more control than the package provides
